items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:56:1
items.html:
And the six last Sefirot of Assiya were in the place where the six first [Sefirot] of Yetzira are now. And here one must remember what the ARI wrote above (page 1903, item 20), that in the womb of Ima only ZON are sorted, and no more, while in the womb of the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut the Rosh [head] of Beria is sorted. Study it there well, throughout the continuation. For this is the rule: every Partzuf is emanated in the upper degree adjacent to it. And with this you will understand that according to the present state of the worlds, in which ZA is in the discernment of VAK [six ends] and the Nukva in the discernment of a point, from the side of the permanent state, it is utterly impossible, from this state, for the Rosh of Beria to come out of the womb of the Nukva of Atzilut; for when she is not in the discernment of a Partzuf even for herself, how could she emanate a second Partzuf beneath her? And this is the rule: a Partzuf cannot emanate a Partzuf lower than itself before it grows in itself to the discernment of Neshama, as the ARI wrote above, page 772, item 60.
And this is why the ARI elaborated here in explaining the order of the emergence of BYA from their beginning: to teach us that the worlds were not then in the same state as now, in which ZA is in the discernment of VAK and the Nukva in the discernment of a point. Rather, ZA was then at the level of Aba, which is the discernment of the Mochin of Haya, and the Nukva was at the level of Ima, which is the Mochin of Neshama; and then Beria could be sorted in the womb of the Nukva until it was completed and could sort the world of Yetzira, and likewise Yetzira the world of Assiya.
And with what has been said, the order of the state of the three worlds BYA that the ARI wrote here is also understood. For it is known that when the lower one rises to the one above it, it then becomes exactly like the degree of the upper one, as the ARI writes below in item 60. It follows that the Nukva, who rose to the level of Ima, becomes exactly like Ima, and everything that is emanated from Ima is regarded as the degree of ZA, for in the womb of Ima only discernments of ZA are sorted, as the ARI wrote above (page 1923, item 20). If so, it is necessary that all ten Sefirot of Beria were in the place of ZA, for when the Nukva is the discernment of Ima, Beria, which is emanated from her, is at the degree of ZA.
And likewise, since the world of Beria was then at the degree of ZA, it follows that in the world of Yetzira, which is emanated from it, its first four Sefirot are regarded as being at the degree of the Nukva of ZA, who clothes ZA from his Chazeh [chest] downward. For since Beria is at the degree of ZA, what is emanated from ZA is always the discernment of his Nukva. But there are two degrees in the Nukva, which are: back to back with ZA from the Chazeh downward, and face to face with ZA at an equal level. And since the state of the worlds in general was still in the discernment of back to back before Adam HaRishon was created, as is known — for even ZON themselves, who had risen to AVI, were still in the discernment of back to back, since ZA rose to Aba, called the upper AVI, while the Nukva rose only to Ima, called YESHSUT, so that the Nukva clothes there only from the Chazeh downward of ZA, in the manner in which YESHSUT clothe the upper AVI; thus the upper ZON, too, are only in the discernment of from the Chazeh downward, back to back — therefore, although the world of Yetzira received the discernment of the Nukva of ZA because of its emergence from Beria, which was the discernment of ZA, as above, even so it received only the first degree of the Nukva, that is, the discernment of from the Chazeh downward of ZA, back to back. And for this reason only the first four of Yetzira became the degree of the Nukva of ZA, while the six lower ones of Yetzira descended to the discernment of the Beria of now, that is, below the Parsa of Atzilut; for the discernment of the Nukva of ZA, when she is back to back from the Chazeh downward, occupies only four Sefirot in Atzilut, and the rest of her Sefirot are in Beria.
And likewise, since the world of Yetzira became the degree of the Nukva of ZA, it follows that in the world of Assiya, which came out of it, the first four Sefirot of Assiya are regarded as having become the degree of the world of Beria; for in the womb of the Nukva of ZA only the world of Beria is sorted. But since the Nukva herself had only the first four Sefirot in Atzilut, while the six lower Sefirot were at the degree of the first six of the world of Beria, therefore the world of Assiya, which was sorted by her, likewise had only its first four Sefirot in the world of Beria, since they extend from the first four Sefirot of the Nukva; but its six lower ones are regarded as having been emanated from the six lower ones of the Nukva, which were at the degree of Beria, and everything that comes out of the degree of Beria is regarded as the degree of the world of Yetzira. Therefore the six lower ones of the world of Assiya descended to the first six of the world of Yetzira.
Thus the necessity of the state of the worlds and of their degree has been well explained: that they are compelled to be according to the order that the ARI details here. For no sorting is possible in the womb of the Nukva before she attains a Partzuf of Neshama; if so, she must clothe Ima. And since the Nukva was standing at the degree of Ima, then all the states that the ARI wrote are necessarily so, as explained. You will also perceive here that all the worlds BYA came out of the Nukva of Atzilut. For besides the fact that the world of Beria came out of the Nukva that is in the place of Ima, the world of Assiya too, when it came out of Yetzira — Yetzira was then at the very degree of the Nukva of Atzilut, as above. It follows that the whole world of Assiya also came out of the Nukva of Atzilut, but from the discernment of back to back of the Nukva, as above.
